methods.name: ShapeFormer
methods.summary: ShapeFormer is an encoder-decoder model for landslide detection. The encoder consists of a scale feature extraction branch using a Pyramid Vision Transformer (PVT) and a shape feature extraction branch that uses boundary attention to enhance landslide shape information. The decoder uses deconvolutional layers and skip connections to recover the original resolution and produce a pixel-wise landslide probability map.
methods.source: Pengyuan Lv, Lusha Ma, Qiaomin Li, and Fang Du
methods.verbatim: In this article, to better extract and keep the multiscale shape information of landslides, a shape-enhanced vision transformer (ShapeFormer) model is proposed.

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory datasets are referenced but not linked, and the custom ShapeFormer code is mentioned without a repository or persistent link.
